Dialogue_Text: "The rotting orb was levitating in the center of a damp cave. A zombie beholder, who was believed to be dead for a century, or mayhap more. Undead and wild, at the very same time. When it saw any living creature, it would bite them with its powerful maw. This is a dead magic area, so it was used to fighting the unfortunate with its sharp teeth."
A zombie beholder? And most likely an angered one. It deserves to be destroyed, and that is exactly what we should do to it.

This one can only be faced in a one-on-one battle. That is why the fee for this one isn't 3,500 gold pieces, but slightly lower: 3,000 coins, and you may face it. The same person will learn from that book.
Fine. It's only fair for the original leader, <PLAYER1>, to face this thing.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Of course! So, let's start the process.
